title: Change to our key, wrapped in another script type

wallet.mnemonic: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about

attack: The change pays our own key at the change path, but as P2PKH while the wallet is P2WPKH. The seed can still spend it, but the wallet that watches this account will not see it, so the user believes the funds are gone until someone tells them where to look.
rule: Show it as a spend (or warn): it is not change of the wallet being used.
